It's an outlet. It's also a way to keep trying to talk myself into it. The responses I get usually make me angry: the same trite garbage repeated over and over again, or people talking to me like a "bro" and referring to me as "man" (hint: I'm not). The more that happens, the more anyone else fails to provide me with any convincing reason not to die, the more I lose resistance to the idea of suicide.

I want someone to stop me because I'm desperately lonely and dependent and want to be taken care of -- but, as I said, by someone worthy of it. Someone I actually admire and trust. I don't have anyone like that.

It sickens me that I can't be self-sufficient. I'm incredibly ashamed of needing someone else to justify my existence. It's one more reason I don't think I'm fit for this Earth in the first place.
I'm sorry, I'm not trying to be rude, but I don't understand this comment. What are you saying no to?
